copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要批量操作Amara上的字幕任务。
copy.tagline_en: Automate Amara subtitling tasks via Rube MCP
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently manage subtitles on Amara.

howto.what: 装上后，你可以让Claude通过Rube MCP自动操作Amara平台（如管理字幕、视频任务）。Claude会先搜索最新工具列表，再执行对应操作。
howto.when: 当你要求执行Amara相关任务（如查找字幕、创建任务）时触发。需要先完成Rube MCP连接并确保Amara连接为活跃状态。

say.text: 帮我查找Amara上某视频的字幕状态
say.note: Claude会搜索Amara工具并返回结果

say.text: 创建一个新的字幕翻译任务
say.note: Claude会使用对应工具创建任务

howto.what_en: Allows you to automate Amara tasks (e.g., subtitle management, video assignments) via Rube MCP. Claude first searches for available tools, then executes the appropriate operation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to perform Amara-related tasks (such as finding subtitles or creating tasks). Requires prior connection to Rube MCP and an active Amara connection.

say_en.text: Find the subtitle status for a video on Amara.
say_en.note: Claude searches Amara tools and returns results.

say_en.text: Create a new subtitle translation task.
say_en.note: Claude uses the corresponding tool to create the task.

say_en.text: Check if the Amara connection is active.
